verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's docs say the API is versioned ("our second API version") and make a first-party stability commitment to avoid breaking changes so integrations keep working. That is a backward-compatibility promise, not a formal deprecation policy. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with notice periods or sunset timelines, a version-selection mechanism (URL/header) and changelog, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: This is our second API version.
We avoid breaking changes at all costs and we won't let your application stop working because of a change we made.
